meta.name: thesis-reviewer
meta.description: Use when the user wants to review, evaluate, or provide feedback on a master's or doctoral thesis (硕士/博士学位论文). Triggers on keywords like "论文评审", "学位论文", "thesis review", "审阅论文", "论文修改意见", "硕士论文", "博士论文", "毕业论文", "doctoral thesis", "PhD thesis". Supports all disciplines with discipline-specific review modules (life sciences, medicine, CS/AI, engineering, chemistry, physics, social sciences). Full-spectrum review: academic quality, writing quality, formatting, data analysis, and academic integrity. Adapts review standards based on degree level and discipline.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评审硕博论文，给出学术质量与写作反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要审阅或修改硕士/博士学位论文
copy.tagline_en: Review master's or doctoral theses with academic feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate or improve a graduate thesis

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成一位论文评审导师，能对硕士或博士论文进行系统化评审，覆盖学术质量、写作、格式、数据和学术诚信五大维度，并给出带严重程度标记的修改意见。
howto.when: 当你提到“论文评审”、“学位论文”、“thesis review”等关键词，或要求审阅一篇 .docx 格式的学位论文时触发。

say.text: 请帮我评审这篇硕士论文，路径是 /path/to/thesis.docx。
say.note: Claude 会转换文件并开始自动分析。

say.text: 检查一下第三章的实验设计有没有问题。
say.note: Claude 会定位到该章进行深入分析。

say.text: 把第二章的评审意见从严重改为建议修改。
say.note: Claude 会记录调整并更新报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a thesis review mentor that systematically evaluates master's or doctoral theses across five dimensions: academic quality, writing quality, formatting, data analysis, and academic integrity, providing severity-marked feedback.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "论文评审", "学位论文", "thesis review", or ask to review a .docx thesis file.

say_en.text: Please review this master's thesis at /path/to/thesis.docx.
say_en.note: Claude will convert the file and start automatic analysis.

say_en.text: Check the experimental design in Chapter 3 for issues.
say_en.note: Claude will locate the chapter and perform in-depth analysis.

say_en.text: Change the severity of the comment on Chapter 2 from critical to suggestion.
say_en.note: Claude will record the adjustment and update the report.
